recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a female subject seated on a light-colored stone floor beneath a polished black grand piano. The scene uses dramatic backlighting to create a halo effect, paired with a sophisticated, two-tiered typographic lockup at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by the dark mass of the piano above and the light stone floor below
High-contrast interplay between the deep blacks of the piano/dress and the bright floor highlights
Contrast between the fluid, ornate script of the primary text and the rigid, spaced sans-serif secondary text
coreInvariants: Polished black grand piano with ornate carved legs
Dramatic lens flare or bright light source from the left background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame in a seated pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy mass of the grand piano lid and the ornate leg on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the diagonal line of her legs down to the boots, and rests on the large typographic branding at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the floor in the foreground and the dark underside of the piano.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays in the piano and subject's attire.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream and off-white tones of the stone floor and skin highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red for the secondary typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall, leaning toward a monochromatic look with high value contrast between light and shadow.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, white, gray, and one spot color

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast script with extreme flourishes and swashes
Swashes extend from the descenders and ascenders to frame the word
Secondary text is a wide-tracked, bold geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'M' features a large, circular swash starting from the left
The final letter of the script name extends a long, looping tail underneath the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, flowing script and rigid, mechanical sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule-like spacing created by the wide tracking of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary formal flourishes and high contrast.
Clean geometric structure for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A woman with dark wavy hair sitting on a light-colored flagstone floor underneath a glossy black grand piano. Dramatic lighting with a bright flare from the left background. She wears a black velvet dress and dark leather boots. High contrast, cinematic photography style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ornate black script name across the bottom foreground. Below it, add a secondary title in bold red geometric sans-serif with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the piano leg ornate and carved?
Is there a visible light flare in the background?
Does the script text have long, decorative swashes?
Is the secondary text red and widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the background light flare
Color of the secondary text accent
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's pose feels natural and integrated with the piano structure.
Check that the script flourishes do not obscure the secondary text.
Verify the stone floor texture is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the red accent color is dark enough to maintain sophistication.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Person/Object] + Environment [Piano/Stone Floor] + Lighting [High-Contrast/Flare] + Typography [Ornate Script/Wide Sans-Serif]
